parsed.justification: Rationale A correctly interprets the scoring rubric, noting that the comment identifies a weakness but lacks depth and actionable detail, placing it at score 3. It is well-grounded in the text and avoids unsupported claims. Rationale B attempts to justify the same score but is less precise in rubric application—it does not clearly commit to a score, instead describing strengths and weaknesses vaguely. B also makes an unsupported claim ('strong suggestion for improvement') that overstates the comment's quality given its vagueness. Additionally, B's coverage of the rubric criteria is less explicit regarding where exactly the comment falls on the scale.
